verdict.rationale: Riveter documents an official MCP integration with two connection modes: a hosted remote endpoint at https://mcp.riveterhq.com/mcp added as a custom connector, and a local server that needs Node.js and an API key. It names Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP-compatible assistant as clients. missing for 10: documentation of which tools or operations the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use Riveter from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI assistant. Pick one of the two ways to connect.
Add https://mcp.riveterhq.com/mcp as a custom connector, then click Connect. ... Nothing runs on your machine.
Runs on your machine and needs Node.js and an API key. Use it when your client cannot reach remote servers.
